inventionTitles.title: 一种生物基因提取仪器

section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因提取仪器，涉及生物基因技术领域，包括离心机，所述离心机的一侧固定连接有滑道，所述滑道的内壁搭接有推拉门，所述离心机的一侧表面搭接有防晃动机构，所述离心机的底部固定连接有底座，所述底座的底部固定连接有固定机构。本实用新型当离心机开始工作带动底座晃动时，橡胶垫接触地面，增大摩擦增加稳定性，当离心机继续晃动，挤压连接柱，连接柱开始挤压减震组件，同时上连接板和固定板同时开始挤压，第一阻尼器和第一弹簧在上连接板的挤压下推动活动圆柱在活动套筒中移动，解决了目前离心机在工作时，转速过高，使得离心机在运行时会因为自身发出的震动，而导致与平台的固定出现松动最后出现侧翻的情况。

The utility model discloses a biological gene draws instrument relates to biological gene technical field, including centrifuge, one side fixedly connected with slide of centrifuge, the inner wall overlap joint of slide has the push-and-pull door, one side surface overlap joint of centrifuge has anti-rocking mechanism, centrifuge's bottom fixedly connected with base, the bottom fixedly connected with fixed establishment of base. The utility model discloses when centrifuge begins work and drives the base and rock, rubber pad contact ground, increase friction increases stability, continue to rock when centrifuge, the extrusion spliced pole, the spliced pole begins to extrude shock-absorbing component, upper junction plate and fixed plate begin to extrude simultaneously, first attenuator and first spring push movable cylinder and remove in the movable sleeve under the extrusion of upper junction plate, solved present centrifuge at the during operation, the rotational speed is too high, make centrifuge can be because the vibrations that self sent when the operation, and lead to appearing not hard up the condition of turning on one's side at last with the fixed of platform.

Biological gene extraction instrumentTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological gene technical field, concretely relates to biological gene draws instrument.

Background

Because the gene is a DNA fragment with genetic effect, supports the basic structure and performance of life, stores all information of processes such as race, blood type, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and the like of life, and is an intrinsic factor determining the health of life, the gene has double attributes: the centrifuge is a machine for separating components from liquid and solid particles or a mixture of liquid and liquid by using centrifugal force, and is also one of extraction means in the aspect of gene extraction.

The following problems exist in the prior art:

at present, when a centrifugal machine works, the rotating speed is too high, so that the centrifugal machine can loose from a platform and finally turn over due to vibration generated by the centrifugal machine when the centrifugal machine works; at present at centrifuge operation in-process, because the rotational speed is higher for equipment can produce vibrations and be in unstable state, and lack the stable supporting mechanism to centrifuge among the prior art, and can not fix centrifuge well, easily take place to rock and the condition such as offset at the during operation.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model provides a biological gene extraction instrument to solve the problem that above-mentioned background proposed.

In order to solve the technical problem, the utility model discloses the technical scheme who adopts is:

the utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument, includes centrifuge, one side fixedly connected with slide of centrifuge, the inner wall overlap joint of slide has the push-and-pull door, one side surface overlap joint of centrifuge has anti-rocking mechanism, centrifuge's bottom fixedly connected with base, the bottom fixedly connected with fixed establishment of base.

The fixing mechanism comprises a connecting column, the top of the connecting column is fixedly connected with the bottom of the base, a fixing cylinder is movably sleeved outside the connecting column, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixing cylinder, a rubber pad is fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixing plate, and a damping assembly is fixedly connected to the top of the fixing plate.

The anti-shaking mechanism comprises a fixed rubber pad, one side surface of the fixed rubber pad is in lap joint with the surface of the centrifugal machine, one end of the fixed rubber pad is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, and one side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a push rod.

The utility model discloses technical scheme's further improvement lies in: the shock-absorbing component comprises an upper connecting plate, the top of the upper connecting plate is fixedly connected with the bottom of the connecting column, a first damper is fixedly connected with the bottom of the upper connecting plate, a first spring is fixedly connected with the bottom of the upper connecting plate, and an upper push plate is fixedly connected with the bottom of the first spring.

The utility model discloses technical scheme's further improvement lies in: the bottom fixedly connected with activity cylinder of push pedal, the bottom fixedly connected with push pedal down of activity cylinder, the bottom fixedly connected with second attenuator of push pedal down, the bottom fixedly connected with second spring of push pedal down.

The utility model discloses technical scheme's further improvement lies in: the outer surface of the movable cylinder is movably sleeved with a movable sleeve, and one end of the movable sleeve is fixedly connected with a supporting plate.

The utility model discloses technical scheme's further improvement lies in: one end fixedly connected with connecting rod of push rod, the one end fixedly connected with lower rack of connecting rod.

The utility model discloses technical scheme's further improvement lies in: the outer surface of the lower rack is connected with a gear in a meshed mode, the inner wall of the gear is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, and the surface of the gear is connected with an upper rack in a meshed mode.

Owing to adopted above-mentioned technical scheme, the utility model discloses relative prior art, the technological progress who gains is:

1. the utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument, adopt the spliced pole, the fixed plate, fixed cylinder, the rubber pad, shock-absorbing component, the upper junction plate, first attenuator, first spring, the top board, the activity cylinder, a supporting plate, the bottom board, the second attenuator, cooperation between the second spring, when centrifuge begins work and drives the base and rock, rubber pad contact ground, increase friction increases stability, continue to rock when centrifuge, the extrusion spliced pole, the spliced pole begins to extrude shock-absorbing component, upper junction plate and fixed plate begin to extrude simultaneously, first attenuator and first spring push the activity cylinder and remove in the movable sleeve under the extrusion of upper junction plate, second spring and second attenuator also move in the movable sleeve promoting activity cylinder simultaneously, make activity cylinder round trip movement reach absorbing purpose, solved present centrifuge at the during operation, the rotational speed is too high, make centrifuge can be because the vibrations that self sent when the operation, and lead to appear becoming flexible the condition that turns on one's side at last appearing.

2. The utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument, adopt the gear, the axis of rotation, lower rack, go up the rack, the connecting rod, the push rod, the connecting plate, cooperation between the solid fixed rubber pad, it is rotatory that the motor drives the axis of rotation, the axis of rotation drives the gear rotation, it removes to drive rack and last rack down when the gear is rotatory, it removes to go up rack and lower rack drive connecting rod, the connecting rod promotes push rod and connecting plate and removes, the connecting plate promotes solid fixed rubber pad and makes solid fixed rubber pad contact centrifuge and play fixed effect, prevent that it from rocking, solved at present at centrifuge operation in-process, because the rotational speed is higher, make equipment can produce vibrations and be in unstable state, and lack the stable supporting mechanism to centrifuge among the prior art, and can not fix with the centrifuge well, easily take place to rock and the condition such as skew at the during operation.

Detailed Description

The present invention will be described in further detail with reference to the following examples:

example 1

As shown in fig. 1-4, the utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument, including centrifuge 1, one side fixedly connected with slide 2 of centrifuge 1, slide 2's inner wall overlap joint has push-and-pull door 3, one side surface overlap joint of centrifuge 1 has anti-rocking mechanism 4, centrifuge 1's bottom fixedly connected with base 5, base 5's bottom fixedly connected with fixed establishment 6, fixed establishment 6 includes spliced pole 61, spliced pole 61's top and base 5's bottom fixed connection, fixed cylinder 63 has been cup jointed in spliced pole 61's outside activity, fixed cylinder 63's bottom fixedly connected with fixed plate 62, fixed plate 62's bottom fixedly connected with rubber pad 64, fixed plate 62's top fixedly connected with damper 65, anti-rocking mechanism 4 includes fixed rubber pad 48, a side surface of fixed rubber pad 48 and centrifuge 1's surface overlap joint, fixed rubber pad 48's one end fixedly connected with connecting plate 47, one side fixedly connected with push rod 46 of connecting plate 47.

In this embodiment, when centrifuge starts work and drives the base and rock, rubber pad 64 contacts ground, increase friction and increase stability, continue to rock when centrifuge, extrude spliced pole 61, spliced pole 61 begins to extrude damping component 65, reach the absorbing purpose, the motor drives axis of rotation 42 rotatory, axis of rotation 42 drives gear 41 rotatory, it removes to drive rack 43 and last rack 44 down when gear 41 is rotatory, it removes to go up rack 44 and lower rack 43 drive connecting rod 45, connecting rod 45 promotes push rod 46 and connecting plate 47 and removes, connecting plate 47 promotes fixing rubber pad 48 and makes fixing rubber pad 48 contact centrifuge 1 and play fixed effect, prevent that it from rocking.

Example 2

As shown in fig. 1-4, on the basis of embodiment 1, the utility model provides a technical solution: preferably, the damping assembly 65 includes an upper connecting plate 651, the top of the upper connecting plate 651 is fixedly connected with the bottom of the connecting column 61, the bottom of the upper connecting plate 651 is fixedly connected with a first damper 652, the bottom of the upper connecting plate 651 is fixedly connected with a first spring 653, the bottom of the first spring 653 is fixedly connected with an upper pushing plate 654, the bottom of the upper pushing plate 654 is fixedly connected with a movable cylinder 655, the bottom of the movable cylinder 655 is fixedly connected with a lower pushing plate 658, the bottom of the lower pushing plate 658 is fixedly connected with a second damper 659, the bottom of the lower pushing plate 658 is fixedly connected with a second spring 650, the outer surface of the movable cylinder 655 is movably sleeved with a movable sleeve 656, and one end of the movable sleeve 656 is fixedly connected with a supporting plate 657.

In this embodiment, when the centrifuge starts to work and drives the base to shake, the rubber pads 64 contact the ground, increase friction and increase stability, when the centrifuge continues to shake, the connecting column 61 is squeezed, the connecting column 61 starts to squeeze the shock-absorbing component 65, and simultaneously the upper connecting plate 651 and the fixing plate 62 start to squeeze simultaneously, the first damper 652 and the first spring 653 push the movable cylinder 655 to move in the movable sleeve 656 under the squeezing of the upper connecting plate 651, and simultaneously the second spring 650 and the second damper 659 also push the movable cylinder 655 to move in the movable sleeve 656, so that the movable cylinder 655 moves back and forth to achieve the shock-absorbing purpose.

Example 3

As shown in fig. 1-4, on the basis of embodiment 1, the utility model provides a technical solution: preferably, one end of the push rod 46 is fixedly connected with a connecting rod 45, one end of the connecting rod 45 is fixedly connected with a lower rack 43, the outer surface of the lower rack 43 is engaged and connected with a gear 41, the inner wall of the gear 41 is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft 42, and the surface of the gear 41 is engaged and connected with an upper rack 44.

In this embodiment, the motor drives the rotation shaft 42 to rotate, the rotation shaft 42 drives the gear 41 to rotate, the gear 41 drives the lower rack 43 and the upper rack 44 to move when rotating, the upper rack 44 and the lower rack 43 drive the connecting rod 45 to move, the connecting rod 45 pushes the push rod 46 and the connecting plate 47 to move, and the connecting plate 47 pushes the fixing rubber pad 48 to enable the fixing rubber pad 48 to contact with the centrifuge 1 to achieve a fixing effect, so as to prevent the centrifuge from shaking.

The operation principle of the biological gene extracting apparatus will be described in detail below.

As shown in fig. 1-4, when the centrifuge starts to work and drives the base to shake, the rubber pad 64 contacts the ground, increasing friction and increasing stability, when the centrifuge continues to shake, the connecting column 61 is pressed, the connecting column 61 starts to press the shock absorbing assembly 65, and simultaneously the upper connecting plate 651 and the fixing plate 62 start to press at the same time, the first damper 652 and the first spring 653 push the movable cylinder 655 to move in the movable sleeve 656 under the pressing of the upper connecting plate 651, and simultaneously the second spring 650 and the second damper 659 also push the movable cylinder 655 to move in the movable sleeve 656, so that the movable cylinder 655 moves back and forth to achieve the shock absorbing purpose, the motor drives the rotating shaft 42 to rotate, the rotating shaft 42 drives the gear 41 to rotate, and when the gear 41 rotates, the lower rack 43 and the upper rack 44 are driven to move, the upper rack 44 and the lower rack 43 drive the connecting rod 45 to move, the connecting rod 45 drives the push rod 46 and the connecting plate 47 to move, and the connecting plate 47 pushes the fixing rubber pad 48 to make the fixing rubber pad 48 contact the fixing rubber pad 48 to the centrifuge 1 to achieve a fixing effect, so as to prevent the shaking.

The present invention has been described in detail with reference to the above general description, but it will be apparent to one of ordinary skill in the art that modifications and improvements can be made to the invention. Therefore, modifications or improvements without departing from the spirit of the invention are within the scope of the invention.
